Malastare Narrows?|Anakin Skywalker, on Trench|audio=WasntHeVaporized-CatAndMouse.flac|}} The '''Battle of Malastare Narrows''' was a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Space warfare/Legends|engagement]] that took place at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]]. After reaching disputes with Malastarian [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] companies over [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] allocations, the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] elected to [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] Malastare to force an agreement in their favor. To that end the Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] blockaded the [[Malastare Narrows/Legends|Malastare Narrows]] with a [[Corporate fleet (Malastare)/Legends|corporate fleet]], leading the Dugs to appeal for assistance from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Though publicly demurring to send aid, Valorum feared that the Alliance would triumph if the conflict escalated into a shooting war. Valorum thus equipped Malastare behind-the-scenes with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|funds]] for [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]], as well as such [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] "observers" as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] of the [[Kwymar Sector Forces]] to overturn the Alliance's blockade of the Malastare Narrows. During the ensuing battle between the Alliance and Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], Trench used his ruthlessly efficient tactics to tear the Republic ships apart, nearly succeeding in eradicating Yularen's forces. Eventually, a task force led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kep-She/Legends|Kep-She]] was sent to intervene and reinforced the remainder of Yularen's task force, overpowering Trench's [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] and forcing the Corporate Alliance to retreat from Malastare. Although the vaporization of [[Trench's flagship/Legends|Trench's flagship]] led to the presumption of his [[Death/Legends|death]], he survived the battle and returned to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|fight]] Yularen during the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Christophsis blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], [[22 BBY/Legends|over a decade later]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|A corporate fleet was blockading Malastare, a fleet led by Trench.|Wullf Yularen|audio=AFleetLedByTrench-CaM.flac|}} [[File:MalastareFuelLines-TZB.png|thumb|left|250px|Disputes over Malastare's fuel allocations led to full-blown conflict with the Corporate Alliance.]] In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] encountered a disagreement about [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] allocations with [[Dug/Legends|Dug]]-run companies on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]–aligned [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. Not satisfied with [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] solutions, the Corporate Alliance resorted to forceful means to settle the dispute on its terms. The successful and ruthless [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] was thus appointed by the Alliance to oversee an assault on Malastare. After [[Sikurdian/Legends|Sikurdian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] hired by the Alliance seized Malastare's fuel [[Tanker/Legends|tankers]], Trench moved in with a [[Corporate fleet (Malastare)/Legends|fleet]] of [[Fantail-class destroyer/Legends|''Fantail''-class destroyers]] and Sikurdian [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] to [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] the [[Malastare Narrows/Legends|Malastare Narrows]], leading his forces from his [[Trench's flagship/Legends|flagship]]. When the Alliance spurned all of their attempts at diplomacy, the Dugs appealed to Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] to intervene on their behalf in the escalating situation. Despite publicly declining to dispatch aid to Malastare, Valorum feared that the Alliance might claim victory if the hostilities resulted in a shooting war, for the Republic's [[Dustig Sector Forces]], which protected Malastare as part of the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]], had been crippled by corruption and neglect to the point of being unable to provide proper support. With his public refusal to send aid, Valorum turned to private methods to arm the Dugs against Admiral Trench and the Corporate Alliance. Behind the scenes Valorum convinced the neighboring [[Tyus sector/Legends|Tyus]] and [[Var Hagen sector/Legends|Var Hagen sectors]] to provide aid to Malastare, as well as passing [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the Dugs to hire privateer [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to match those of Trench. To coordinate the Dugs' [[Navy/Legends|naval]] defenses, Valorum sent [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] whose publicly stated objective was to "observe" the situation. Among the officers was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] of the [[Kwymar Sector Forces]], a capable [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who had previously battled Sikurdian pirates during his career. Yularen and his comrades marshaled the Dugs' forces for the impending confrontation with Trench. ==The battle== {{Quote|He tore our ships apart. We barely escaped with our lives. In the end, a Jedi-led task force moved in to settle the matter. Trench's ship was destroyed and we assumed he went down with it.''"
"''Are you sure it's him?''"
"''It's possible. Not every captain goes down with his ship.|Wullf Yularen and Anakin Skywalker|audio=HeToreOurShipsApart-CaM.flac|}} [[File:Admiral_Yularen.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Battle of Malastare Narrows became Captain Yularen's first defeat.]] Equipped with dozens of starships, including the privateer ships and the forces from the Tyus and Var Hagen [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], Captain Yularen and his men [[Space warfare/Legends|engaged]] Trench in battle, opposing Trench's own ''Fantail''-class [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]] and Sikurdian privateers over the Malastare Narrows. However, Trench's ruthless and efficient tactics soon left Yularen outmaneuvered, nearly wiping out the entirety of the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab0274ee03e01279bad376804c0|text=Dataclip: Cat and Mouse|na=video file}} Yularen and his crew lost a number of good men to Trench's forces, though they held out until reinforcements could arrive. In the end a task force commanded by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kep-She/Legends|Kep-She]]—another one of the military "observers" dispatched by Valorum to Malastare—moved in to intervene, saving the remnants of Yularen's fleet that were still engaging Trench. In the resulting fight, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led task force vaporized Trench's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. Without Trench's leadership the Alliance fleet was forced to retreat from Malastare, resulting in a Republic victory, albeit a costly one.{{SWE|characters|admiraltrench|Admiral Trench}} Trench, meanwhile, survived the explosion of his flagship, thanks to an [[Andoan mineral-fish]] [[Environment suit/Legends|pressure suit]] and his natural toughness as a member of the [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|The last time I saw that symbol, well, let's just say I lost a lot of good men that day.|Wullf Yularen, on Trench's unmistakable insignia|audio=LostALotOfGoodMen-CaM.flac|}} [[File:Trench.png|thumb|left|250px|Admiral Trench survived the battle and continued his career at Christophsis.]] By the [[Time/Legends|time]] the battle was over, Yularen had lost dozens of ships and the majority of his forces in the assault. Even with the Republic victorious and Trench declared [[Death/Legends|dead]] following the engagement,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' the battle was considered to be Yularen's first defeat. Remembered as a terrible loss for the amount of casualties, the Battle of Malastare Narrows, as it came to be known, sparked [[Politics/Legends|political]] turmoil for Chancellor Valorum, who was already under fire and was left embarrassed by the scandal following the battle. The Corporate Alliance's loss at Malastare remained as a lesson for other [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] cartels such as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], which kept note of the Republic's response to Malastare in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], when it planned an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the Republic world [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Although Trench was presumed dead by the Republic, many years later during the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' he continued his career within the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Despite his declared death, Trench was still considered to be undefeated.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/cat_and_mouse_weekly/index.html|text=Anakin Faces Off Against An Infamous Separatist Strategist}} While [[Christophsis blockade/Legends|blockading]] the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] in 22 BBY, Trench again encountered Yularen, himself now an admiral in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], when he and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] attempted to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|break Trench's blockade]]. With his firsthand account of Trench's tactics and maneuvers at Malastare, Yularen came to accompany Skywalker on a mission to deliver supplies through Trench's blockade via an experimental [[Stealth ship/Legends|stealth ship]]. The Battle of Christophsis resulted in Trench's defeat and the destruction of his then-flagship, the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] [[Invincible/Legends|''Invincible'']], and Trench was once again listed as killed in action. Nevertheless, Yularen doubted that Trench had perished, given the latter's survival at the Malastare Narrows. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|More detail about the Harch, how Wullf Yularen had fought Trench before, and how that fight happened at Malastare if Yularen served far away in the Kwymar Sector Forces. Some retcons are best navigated speedily without dwelling on the details too long.|Author [[Jason Fry]], in his endnotes to ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', regarding the section on Admiral Trench|{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22588801475/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-6|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 6}}}} The Battle of Malastare Narrows was created for the [[2010]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode "[[Cat and Mouse]]," and served as a backstory to explain Wullf Yularen's previous history with Admiral Trench. Despite the episode's lack of clarification for the chronology of the battle, the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.8|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.8]]'' magazine's biographical article on Admiral Yularen placed the battle prior to the Clone Wars. Though the line mentioning Jedi Master Kep-She as the commander of the intervening task force was cut from the final version of the episode, it remained in the script, and Kep-She was referenced in the episode's [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|official online guide]]. It was not until the publication of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' in [[April]] [[2012]] that the battle's specific date, background, and aftermath were detailed, specifically in relation to the Corporate Alliance and the Republic response to the blockade of Malastare. ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' also identified the Malastare Narrows as the site of the battle, though their [[canon]]ical significance was not clarified. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}} {{1stm}} ==Sources== *{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab0274ee03e01279bad376804c0|text=Dataclip: Cat and Mouse|na=video file}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode216.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cat and Mouse}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.8|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.8]] *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' *''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' *{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars''|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}} *{{SWE|characters|admiraltrench|Admiral Trench}} *{{SWE|characters|yularen|Admiral Wulff Yularen}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/cat-and-mouse-episode-guide|text="Cat and Mouse" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22588801475/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-6|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 6}} {{Interlang |de=Schlacht der Malastare-Enge#legends |es=Batalla de los Estrechos de Malastare/Leyendas |nl=Battle of Malastare Narrows |pl=Blokada Malastare |pt=Legends:Batalha dos Estreitos de Malastare |deGA=1 }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Malastare Narrows, Battle of}} [[Category:Battles during the Great Peace of the Republic]] [[Category:Battles of Malastare]]
